bio.text: Branden Scrivener is running with no party affiliation for Florida's 12th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He graduated from Sunlake High School, earned an associate degree from Hillsborough Community College in 2022 and a bachelor's degree from Indian River State College in 2025.
According to his Ballotpedia survey, he is 27, has a bachelor's in human services, and has worked in healthcare for over three years.
